result.topic_en: Formula-only calculations of integrals and partial derivatives of potential-type functions p, q depending on parameters a, b, c, leading to variational equations in δa, δb and a change of variables x, y for the rotating fluid ellipsoid problem.
result.transcription:
$p=\int\frac{\partial s\, s\, a^{4}(1-a^{6})}{(1+a^{4}s)^{\frac32}(1+\frac{s}{aa})^{2}}=\int\frac{a^{4}\partial s\, s\,(1-a^{6})}{\sqrt{1+\frac{s}{tt}}^{\,3}(1+s)^{2}}=-g\,a^{4}(1-a^{6})=-ag\,[-tt-]z=q$
$\frac{p}{b-a}=\frac{-ga^{3}(1-a^{6})}{a^{3}-1}=-g\,a^{9}(t+1)$
$\frac{q}{b+a}=-g\,a^{9}(t-1)$
$\frac{\partial p}{\partial a}=\frac{4}{a}p-\int\frac{\partial s\, s\,(1-a^{6})\,a^{-7}}{(1+a^{4}s)^{\frac32}(1+\frac{s}{aa})^{3}}+\int\frac{2\partial s\, s\, a^{-4}}{(1+a^{4}s)^{\frac32}(1+\frac{s}{aa})^{3}}=(1-a^{6})(-ga^{3}+\frac14 a^{3}g')+\frac12 h'$
$p\frac{\delta b-\delta a}{b-a}+q\frac{\delta b+\delta a}{b+a}=-ga^{9}2(t\delta b-\delta a)$
$=-ga^{9}2(\delta b-t\delta a)$
$\frac12\frac{\partial(p-q)}{\partial a}=(1-a^{6})(-ga^{3}+\frac14 a^{3}g')=-(1-a^{6})ga^{3}-\frac14 a^{3}h'+ga^{9}=-a^{3}(g+\frac14 h')$
$\frac12\frac{\partial(p+q)}{\partial b}$ [-...-] $\int\frac{\partial s\, s\, a^{-4}(1-a^{6})}{}$
$=2ga^{6}-3\int\frac{s\partial s\, a^{-4}(1-a^{6})}{(1+a^{4}s)^{\frac32}(1+\frac{s}{aa})^{2}}=-2ga^{6}-(g'-3g)(1-a^{6})=$ [-...-] $-2ga^{6}+3g(1-a^{6})+h'+4ga^{6}=g(3+a^{6})+h'$
$\frac12\frac{\partial(p+q)}{\partial c}=$ [-...-] $(\frac{c}{b}-3\frac{c}{b})-ga^{5}-3\int\frac{s\partial s\, a^{-4}(1-a^{6})}{(1+a^{4}s)^{\frac32}(1+\frac{s}{aa})^{3}}=ga^{3}(3a^{6}-1)+\frac34 g'a^{3}(1-a^{6})=ga^{3}(2a^{6}-1)-\frac34 h'a^{3}+3ga^{9}=-a^{3}(g+\frac34 h')$
$\frac{bc}{b^{2}c^{5}}-\frac{a}{bc^{4}}$
$3ga^{9}(\delta a-t\delta b)+\delta a(-ga^{3}(3a^{6}-1)+(1-a^{6})(-ga^{3}+\frac{1}{2}a^{3}g'))+\delta b\,(1-a^{6})(\;\frac34 g'a^{6}+g'-3g)-\mu\mu\delta b-\mu\mu(a^{6}\delta b+a^{3}\delta a)=0$ {+$-a^{6}(1+3a^{6})g+$+} {+$-\mu\mu\delta b\,uu(2tt-1)$+}
$a^{3}\delta a(3gtt+g(2tt+uu)+uu(g-g'))+\delta b(3gt^{4}-uu(3gtt+\frac34 g'tt+g'-3g))$ [-...-] $+a^{3}\delta a\mu\mu=0$
$\frac12\frac{\partial(q-p)}{\partial a}=+\frac12 h'$
$\frac12\frac{\partial(q-p)}{\partial b}=0$
$\frac12\frac{\partial(q-p)}{\partial c}=\frac12 h'$
$3ga^{9}(\delta b-t\delta a)+\delta b\frac12 a^{3}h'-\mu\mu\delta a-\mu\mu(a^{3}\delta b+\delta a)=0$
$a^{3}\delta b(3gt^{4}+\frac12 h')-\mu\mu)-\delta a(3gt^{4}+2\mu\mu)=0$
$uua^{3}\delta b(3gzz+\frac12 h(zz-1)-\frac{\mu\mu}{uu})$
$6gzz=18z^{6}+g(z^{5}-18z^{7})$
$z^{2}+4z^{4}-3z^{6}+g(z+2z^{3}-3z^{5}+3z^{7})$ {+$-1\quad+2$+}
$6gzz+h(zz-1)=-z^{2}+4z^{4}+15z^{6}+g(z+z^{3}+5z^{5}-15z^{7})$
[-$a^{3}\delta b\,3$-]

$3ga^{9}(\delta b-t\delta a)-(\delta a+\frac12\delta b\,a^{3})(\mu\mu-\frac12 h')=0$
$\delta b-t\delta a=x$
$\delta a+\frac12 t\delta b=y$
$(1+\frac12 tt)\delta b=x+ty$

$-\mu\mu(x+ty)-\mu\mu(1+tt)y+\frac12 tx$

$(\frac12 h'-\mu\mu)y(2+tt)+x(1+\frac12 tt)3ga^{9}$

methods.what: Definition of p as an elliptic-type integral over s for the ellipsoid potential
Partial derivative of p with respect to a by differentiation under the integral
Combination of p and q variations
